name: 32223 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32223 (Jacksonville) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32223 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
